challenge.method: Check whether multiplatform describes only the tooling, whether Java is presented as the same language, and what carries the experimental designation.
challenge.results: The introduction applies the platform description to Kotlin before discussing tooling. It treats Java as an influence and assigns experimental stability specifically to the specification.

limitations: Active is the catalog lifecycle state for the language identity.
